api_base_url.label: App API base URL
api_base_url.info: Your app URL with no trailing slash, e.g. https://my-app.fly.dev. In dev this is the tunnel URL shown by 'shopify app dev'.

campaign_id.label: Campaign ID (optional)
campaign_id.info: Leave blank to show active campaigns configured for this page in Recommendation admin. Enter an ID only to pin one campaign.

product_limit.label: Products to load
product_limit.info: The total number of products available to browse.

columns.label: Desktop products visible
columns.info: Number of product cards visible horizontally on desktop.

mobile_columns.label: Mobile products visible
mobile_columns.info: Number of product cards visible horizontally on mobile.
